description: This file defines the SimpleCredentialHandler class that implements the CredentialHandler interface. It provides methods for matching credentials using login services and mutating credentials (though in this implementation, mutate returns null).

classes.name: SimpleCredentialHandler
classes.description: A class implementing CredentialHandler for credential validation.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the input credentials match the stored credentials using LoginServices.

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Returns null; in this implementation, mutation is not performed, possibly because passwords are stored in plain text or handled externally.
